title: Isolate temporary Git tests from commit-hook repository state
acceptance: Python test children clear exactly Git repository-local environment variables while real candidate/index phases preserve them. A regression proves outer refs/index/config remain unchanged, and a guarded worktree commit succeeds without repository contamination.
evidence: AiCheckTests 12/12 and all Python tooling tests 66/66 passed. The regression injects outer GIT_DIR, GIT_COMMON_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE and GIT_INDEX_FILE, proves the Python-test fixture commits in an isolated repository, confirms the real diff phase retains outer-repository state, and byte-compares outer config, HEAD, index, refs and status before/after.
motivation: Prevent test fixtures from mutating the real repository when commit hooks export absolute worktree Git variables.
context: CI worktree hook inherited repository-local Git environment into Python tests; fixture commits/config affected the CI task branch and shared local config. Protected dev/main and ai-dev/ai-main refs were verified unchanged; exact config restoration is recorded in build/recovery/git-hook-isolation.md. No remote push occurred.
resolution_changes: Sanitized only the Python-test child environment from Git-discovered repository-local variables with fail-closed discovery; added outer-repository non-mutation regression coverage and documented hook-phase environment isolation.
plan: Sanitize only the Python-test child environment using git rev-parse --local-env-vars, failing closed on invalid discovery.
Test injected outer-repository variables and preserve exact index semantics for actual gates.
Verify protected refs/config before and after first corrected worktree commit; recover reviewed CI files without rewriting incident refs.
